question: Why did sales drop?

parsed.answer: Two separate drops occurred. First, cold brew volume fell from about 30-39 per day to 18-24 starting 2026-10-05, coinciding with the price rise from $4.00 to $5.00 from week 5, and reviews complain about the $5 price. Second, revenue fell sharply to $417, $489 and $455 on 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-22 with zero espresso drinks sold. The inbox reports the grinder motor died Tuesday and repair came Friday, and reviews report no espresso for three days and a broken grinder.

citations.quote: From: Dana (barista) - Grinder motor died Tuesday, repair guy came Friday. Sorry!
1,"No espresso for three days, went elsewhere"
2,"Cold brew price jumped to $5, too much"

actions: Complete grinder repair and add preventive maintenance and backup plan
Review cold brew $5 pricing and communicate value or adjust price
Offer remakes to affected espresso customers and monitor sales daily
